entities.name: Raphi Phatthanasak, Prince of Ratchaburi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Raphi Phatthanasak, Prince of Ratchaburi, was a 14th son of king Chulalongkorn and Chao Chom manda Talab. He had one full sister, Princess Ajrabarni Rajkanya.
